title: Sea-to-Sky to Whistler
summary: Pick up the rental car in Vancouver, drive the Sea-to-Sky Highway, and spend the evening in Whistler village.
drive: Vancouver to Whistler · about 2h with stops · 120 km

segments.name: Segment 1 — Rental car pickup and Shannon Falls
segments.blurb: All luggage in the car; no return to the Vancouver Airbnb.

stops.name: Rental car pickup, downtown Vancouver
stops.note: 8:30am pickup; check out of the Airbnb first.

segments.name: Segment 2 — Sea to Sky Gondola, Squamish
segments.blurb: CAD $69pp, summit boardwalk and suspension bridge.

map.center: Sea to Sky Gondola, Squamish, BC

stops.name: Sea to Sky Gondola
stops.note: Open year-round, 10-minute ride to the summit.

stops.name: Sky Pilot Suspension Bridge
stops.note: Suspension bridge at the gondola summit.

stops.name: Squamish viewpoint
stops.note: Views over Howe Sound and the Stawamus Chief.

segments.name: Segment 3 — Whistler village, spa, and dinner
segments.blurb: No alpine gondola — Peak 2 Peak closed for maintenance.

stops.name: Scandinave Spa Whistler
stops.note: CAD $115pp, outdoor Nordic baths, silence policy.

stops.name: Whistler Train Wreck
stops.note: Suspension bridge trail to derailed boxcars.
